name: Heiwa no Saiten de Sen'nou sa Reru Densetsu no Hero-tachi
original_name: 平和の祭典で洗脳される伝説のヒーロー達
source: An IF scenario from the events in the main story of Geeks vs Superheroes as a standalone game, featuring heroes turned to perverts by brainwashing in a festival.
translation: 独立游戏《极客大战超级英雄》主线故事中的IF场景，英雄们在节日中被洗脑变成了变态。
